title: Capstone: A Basin's Water Story
description: Synthesis capstone for the Intro to Hydrology course. Choose one of four CAMELS-US basins, compute hydrological signatures (Lyne–Hollick BFI, Richards–Baker flashiness, flow-duration curve) from five years of observed daily flow, run the TWI pipeline on a synthetic hillslope, then narrate the basin's water story through a 6-stage timeline. Every number comes from a cell or from CAMELS.

citation.text: Newman, A. J. et al. (2015). Development of a large-sample watershed-scale hydrometeorological data set for the contiguous USA. Hydrol. Earth Syst. Sci., 19, 209–223. See also Addor, N. et al. (2017), Hydrol. Earth Syst. Sci., 21, 5293–5313, doi:10.5194/hess-21-5293-2017.

author: Mohammad Galib, Purdue University
